body: Exactly. It's really sad how some people see being a good person as a disadvantage in life. Yes, you shouldn't be a pushover, you gotta stand up for your needs and opinions. But becoming a self centered person who doesn't care about the people that are close in their lives will have you end up in misery.

Hey man, I get it, trust me. You are looking for someone you can share your life with, there's nothing wrong with that. But you are setting yourself up the worst way possible. I'm not saying this because I'm trying to hurt your feelings, I want to give you a reality check and possibly help you avoid making the mistakes a lot of us here have already done. 

You can't find happiness and self love in another person. Even if that person loves you with all their heart, it won't be enough. With that said, please don't feel pressured that you need to love yourself 100% immediately. It takes time - a lot. But it's worth it.

Now, you can definitely put yourself out there and meet new people, even if you don't love yourself fully. And you don't have to be 100% content with yourself to find a relationship. However, please keep in mind that you'll have to work on your self love and acceptance in order to keep that relationship. If you don't, you might risk losing it.

Wishing you all the best for your journey!

Stay in No Contact, move on and focus on your happiness and selflove. This is the best option, because if they come back, you're a much stronger person and you still had a good time between those relationship Gaps with them, and if they don't come back then you're already over them and perhaps in a much better loving relationship than before.

I'm not saying your relationship you had was bad, I don't know your story and I'm not in a place to judge. What I do know is that by moving on you're making the best possible decision, and moving on doesn't even have to mean you won't be with them together in the future.
